fields.authority: Midland State Division of Securities Enforcement
fields.subject: Inquiry into the company's October 2026 cybersecurity incident
fields.summary: The division is reviewing the timing of the company's disclosure of the incident and asks for documents and a written account of the company's decisions.
requests: Documents showing when the incident was first discovered and who knew.
The disclosure committee's minutes and any materiality analysis.
Communications with the board about the incident from October 22 to October 27.
The company's incident response and disclosure policies.
fields.handling: A legal hold is in place. Outside counsel will propose a rolling production and ask for a call about scope.
firstSteps: General Counsel acknowledges receipt within two business days.
Chief Compliance Officer identifies custodians by Friday.
Outside counsel drafts a scope letter.

fields.authority: Midland State Attorney General, Consumer Protection Division
fields.subject: Civil investigative demand about the handling of customer data
fields.summary: The Attorney General's office has served a civil demand about whether customer data was taken in the incident and when customers were told.
requests: All documents about customer data on affected systems.
Notices sent or drafted to customers.
fields.handling: Legal hold in place. The demand is privileged-reviewed by outside counsel before production.
firstSteps: Calendar the response date and the meet-and-confer window.
